title: 卡塔尔说年均增长6%：公开数据却只有1.5%，真实增速到底是多少
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Good afternoon, gentlemen. I think it's afternoon. We've been we've been here for quite some time. So I've lost track a little bit.
segments.zh: 各位下午好。我想现在是下午了。我们在这里待了挺久，有点分不清时间了。

segments.en: Um, I think we've talked a lot today about growth and investment. And Drexansi, I think I want to start with you.
segments.zh: 嗯，今天我们已经谈了很多关于增长和**的话题。Drexansi，我想先从你开始。

segments.en: We talk often about risk and how to mitigate that and how to manage risk, especially when you're doing investments, but I'm wondering if the threshold for panic is lower than it used to be given the uncertainties both in the world of the large and in the region.
segments.zh: 我们经常讨论风险以及如何缓解和管理风险，尤其是在做**的时候。但我想知道，鉴于全球和地区的不确定性，现在恐慌的门槛是不是比以前更低了？

segments.en: And how you work around that, how you mitigate that and if just any examples come to mind about how people are prone to panic at the moment, whether or not it's justified.
segments.zh: 以及你如何应对和缓解这种情况，有没有什么例子能说明人们目前容易恐慌，不管这种恐慌是否合理。

segments.en: Well, Christina, I don't know if our threshold for panic has lowered, but I think a good way of looking at it is that this is not our first radio.
segments.zh: 嗯，Christina，我不确定我们的恐慌门槛是否降低了，但我觉得一个很好的视角是，这不是我们第一次经历这种局面。

segments.en: In the past 10 years, we've had what we've had COVID, we've had oil price crash, we've had the regional instability and yet through all of that, we've had 6% GDP growth year over year.
segments.zh: 过去10年里，我们经历了疫情、油价暴跌、地区不稳定，但尽管如此，我们仍然实现了6%的GDP同比增长。

segments.en: I think we're getting used to it. I think we're learning every crisis we face, we learn and we come out of it stronger. And I would say this is just one of those.
segments.zh: 我想我们正在习惯这种局面。每次面对危机，我们都在学习，并且变得更强大。我想这只是其中之一。

segments.en: Chris, when you look at investments in the Middle East, do you see the current situation as a short-term blip over a longer-term strategy or is this the new real politic and people are going to have to adjust?
segments.zh: Chris，当你看中东的**时，你认为当前局势是长期战略中的短期波动，还是新的现实政治，人们将不得不调整？
